The '''tower briefing room''' was a room for meetings aboard the [[Supertanker fuel depot|refueling station]] ''[[Titan]]''.<ref name="STS" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The tower briefing room first appeared in "[[Station to Station]],"<ref name="STS" /> the eleventh episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[December 15]], [[2019]].<ref name="Disney release">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
